description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Accuracy@1 (%)" and the "Num. of Child Nodes (Tree Width)" for two distinct series, one of which is labeled "GPT-4o" while the other's legend label is obscured. The x-axis represents the number of child nodes on a linear scale ranging from 1 to 7, with numeric tick marks placed at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents accuracy on a linear scale ranging from 15 to 35, measured in percentages (%), with tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The plot features two solid lines with annotated data points. The line representing "GPT-4o" is medium blue with solid circular markers; it begins at an accuracy of 24.4 at an x-value of 1, increases to 28.9 at an x-value of 3, reaches a peak of 34.4 at an x-value of 5, and then declines to end at 31.1 at an x-value of 7. The second line, corresponding to the obscured legend entry, is light blue with 'x' cross markers; it starts at 26.7 at an x-value of 1, rises slightly to a peak of 27.8 at an x-value of 3, decreases to 24.4 at an x-value of 5, and continues to decline, ending at its lowest point of 20.0 at an x-value of 7.
